data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $75,625,000 (2021: $60,654,000) is a deterioration of $10,434,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end (2021: deterioration $5,306,000).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a gross prior-year strengthening of approximately 25.47 (USD millions), representing about a 13.7% increase versus opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development was driven by recalibration of IBNR, an explicit loading for inflation and margins above actuarial best estimates, and broader adverse claims development on 2019/2020 and prior years.
raw_causal_phrases: a provision within claims that have been incurred at the reporting date but have not yet been reported ("IBNR")
a loading for inflation and a margin added over and above actuarial best estimates
back year deterioration on the 2020 and prior years of account on a stand-alone basis
Included within net calendar year claims incurred ... is a deterioration of $10,434,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (25.471m) was calculated from the GROSS claims development triangle (compare current estimate to previous diagonal for UW years <=2020). No explicit single-line gross 'movement in prior year's provision' figure was provided in the notes; a narrative net deterioration ($10.434m) is quoted in the text (net of reinsurance) and is reported verbatim in exact_reserve_text. All monetary values are reported in the syndicate's reporting currency (USD). LOB-level breakdown of prior-year movement is not provided; LOB assignments in lob_movements are inferred from segmental prominence only.
